decisions.reason: As a small extension of the firm's established wooden gift range that also fits its strategic move toward adding technology, this product should be kept because uncertainty is still high after only one season and the option value of learning more is likely greater than the limited cost of continuing it.

This product sits squarely in the firm's core seasonal handcrafted offering, so with no clear negative signal yet it is sensible to keep the option open because it can likely be produced and carried at relatively low risk.

Because this is close to the existing offer while also testing a more contemporary design direction, management should keep it on the market for another period since early uncertainty remains and the learning value is meaningful.
